title: ContextPacket
description: Bounded response of an /internal/ctx/* pull tool. Every packet is logged server-side in context_access_log under the caller's run id.

access_id.description: context_access_log row id; the agent cites it to prove what it read.

world_as_of.description: World-time cutoff the pull was served at (ADR-0019): the run's newest trigger activity occurred_at plus one microsecond, so activities up to and including the trigger are visible and none after it. Always set by this core (every run has a trigger activity); a client must treat null as unknown. Derived by the core from the run; the caller cannot set it.
